rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FARM MACHINERIES MANUFACTURING PROGRAMS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: \"Farm Machineries Manufacturing Program (FMMP) Act of 2004\".  This bill provides for the establishment of a comprehensive program that shall introduce mechanized farming to boast production. It encourages local manufacturers to enter into a joint venture with foreign companies that shall assist and train them with the end in view of enabling them to maximize the utilization of local materials in the products.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2007-08-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE AND DEVELOP THE SEED INDUSTRIES OF THE PHILIPPINES AND TO INSURE THE AVAILABILITY OF HIGH QUALITY SEEDS OF SUPERIOR CROP VARIETIES FOR NATIONAL AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Seed Act\".   This bill seeks to develop the seeds industry in the country in order to produce, through intensive research and study, high quality varieties of seeds and, most importantly, to make them available in sufficient quantities to all farmers throughout the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2007-08-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NEW QUEDAN SYSTEM IN THE MARKETING OF PALAY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: This bill mandates the National Food Authority (NFA) to determine the floor price for palay to assure the farmers or producers a fair return on their investment and to procure and buy from farmers their palay crops subject to the following payment terms: (a)seventy-five percent in cash, and (b) a quedan for the remaining balance which shall be paid within sixty days from the time the palay is delivered to its warehouses or within such time as may be agreed upon by the NFA and the farmers/producers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2007-08-01

rows.title_short: \"2007 Batas Para sa Pagpapaunlad ng mga Barangay\"  (\"The Barangay Development Act of 2007\")
rows.abstract: \"2007 Batas Para sa Pagpapaunlad ng mga Barangay\".  Ang panukalang ito ay naghahangad na mapabilis ang pag-unlad ng lahat ng mga barangay bilang pangungunang bahaging politikal at pang-economiya ng ating bansa sa loob ng itinakdang panahon. Ang panukala ay naglalaan ng panimulang pondo na P20 bilyon para sa programang ito.(\"The Barangay Development Act of 2007\".  The bill seeks to accelerate the development of barangays as the primary political-economic unit through the formulation of a 20-year development program with a seed fund of P20 billion pesos.)

rows.abstract: \"National Food Authority Reorganization Act of 2005\". rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE GOVERNMENT ASSET MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Government Asset Management Act of 2007\". The bill seeks to establish the Government Asset Management Authority (GAMA) that shall be responsible for the privatization and disposition of non-performing government assets and the recovery ill-gotten wealth of government officials. The GAMA is envisioned to take over and continue the powers, functions and duties of the Presidential Commission on Good Government, the Privatization Council and the Privatization Management Office.
